about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Experience and professional background
about.intro:
Systems Engineer and Master's in Software Engineering with 23 years of experience in technology, working on projects for sectors such as healthcare, education, industrial, government, and financial services. Specialized in backend development with Java, with additional expertise in Kotlin and Node.js, on microservices architectures and AWS cloud. I have experience at companies with a presence in several Latin American countries, including Mercado Libre, Rappi, and Nequi.

I'm an early adopter of AI tools applied to software development: active integration of LLM Coding Assistants (Claude Code, Windsurf/Vibe Coding), which has allowed me to accelerate value delivery, reduce technical debt, and lead the adoption of these practices within engineering teams. I had the opportunity to work with an AI-assisted SDD-type solution, which gave me real experience standardizing development at the team level.

A well-rounded profile that combines experience in development, infrastructure (ITIL V3), and project management (CAPM, Scrum Master), with technical vision and leadership skills built over the course of my career.
